business_problem: Edger Finance wanted to help investors collect, summarize and interrogate quarterly-report data much faster so users could make better investment decisions without waiting on manual analyst work.
solution_summary: Working with IBM Client Engineering and IBM Innovation Studio through the IBM Fintechx program, Edger Finance piloted three AI-assisted workflows on top of IBM watsonx.ai and IBM watsonx Assistant. The first produces CEO-style summaries from quarterly reports, the second extracts structured data points from each filing, and the third lets investors ask questions about a report through a chat interface. Watsonx.ai provides the secure model-development and process-automation layer for all three assistants, while watsonx Assistant powers the conversational experience for the Q&A flow. The pilot focused on Swedish- and English-language report processing and proved that generative AI could fit directly into Edger's investment-research platform rather than acting as a side experiment. That architecture turns long-form corporate disclosures into searchable, summarized and queryable assets so investors can move from raw filings to relevant decision support much more quickly.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Runs the report summarization, data-extraction and investment-analysis workflows in Edger's platform.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Assistant
solution_components.role: Enables investors to interact with report data through a question-answer chat flow.

data_flow: Quarterly reports are ingested into watsonx.ai for summarization and data extraction, then the resulting report data is exposed through watsonx Assistant so investors can ask questions and retrieve the information most relevant to their strategy.
business_outcome: Edger sharply reduced turnaround time for report processing, improved platform relevance and personalization for investors, and proved its product could create value for both retail investors and enterprises using financial-report data.
metrics: 90% improvement in the turnaround time for quarterly report data extracts
Approximately 96% improvement in the time it takes to summarize the main points of a 30+ page report
architecture_clues: The MVP pilot ran for four weeks and covered Swedish and English workflows.
One assistant summarizes reports, one extracts data points and one exposes a Q&A interface.
The pilot was designed to fit directly into Edger's investment platform.
